Formula r = sum_ij w_ij (x_i - mx)(y_j - my) / sqrt(sum_ij w_ij (x_i - mx)^2 * sum_ij w_ij (y_j - my)^2); mx = sum_ij w_ij x_i / sum_ij w_ij, my = sum_ij w_ij y_j / sum_ij w_ij. Sums run over directed edges (i, j) with positive weight to another included row; the weights are used as given and the means are edge-weighted, not the plain column means. Clamped to [-1, 1]; NaN for zero weight or zero variance. There is no analytic p-value.
